title: Extending the Cheetah 3D API
summary: Discussion on wrapping PolyCore with helper classes; native objects cannot be extended via prototype.

evidence.author: McShaman
evidence.quote: PolyCore.prototype.myMethod = function() ... This produces an error.

evidence.author: tg_jp
evidence.quote: Currently it seems to be not available to extend an built-in object like Vec3D, PolyCore, etc. using 'prototype'.

evidence.author: Edward
evidence.quote: the number of vertices isn't equal to the number of corners in the model.

api_lessons: Built-in classes (Vec3D, PolyCore, ...) cannot be extended through .prototype, and obj.core() instanceof PolyCore is false; wrap them in your own JS objects instead.
PolyCore vertices are shared/indexed: vertexCount() != number of polygon corners; use vertexIndex(poly, corner) to map corners to vertices.
UVs are returned as vectors (uvCoord(p,c)), so vector math (add) works directly.
notes: tg_jp's wrapper sample calls polygonSize() without an index argument (bug; should be polygonSize(i)).
